Washing

The Process of Latex Banefication i.e Stabilization, Activation, Accelerators', Vulcanization and Anti-Oxidation involves use of some non-hazardous chemicals. The excess residual chemicals appear on the glove surface in the form of surfactants. These surfactants need to be washed away during the process of washing also known as Leaching. The Gloves' Donning Comfort is a direct function of how efficiently the gloves have been leached. The state of Art Technology at Innovative Glove Company Limited provides a 48 meter long leaching of the Gloves to extract all the residual chemicals & surfactants. We have multiple Pre-Leaching and Post Leaching tanks that employ processed water, Hot and Cold, overflowing at 15-20 Liters per minute. The simultaneous use of hot and cold water during multiple leaching stages removes all surfactants and thus provide best Donning Comfort without any skin irritation or allergic discomfort. The Gloves manufactured at Innovative Gloves Company Limited have been tested for Skin Irritation & Sensitivity factor and have duly been accredited to comply with best international standards.
